title: Scalar formal sections on a depth-three complete local puncture
statement: Let R be a Noetherian local ring [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring], complete for its maximal ideal [def-weil-pbc-adic-completion], of depth at least three [def-weil-pbc-depth]. Let g belong to its maximal ideal, W be its punctured spectrum [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions], and f:R to R/(g) be the quotient map. Every family of scalar sections on the opens in Spec(R/(g)^(n+1)) over W, compatible under quotient transition maps, is the reduction of a unique section of O_W. The thickenings and comparison maps are those of [lem-sbc-finite-etale-adic-sections-transfer].

proof.text: The quotient kernel I is (g), contained in the maximal ideal. Completeness for subideals gives IsAdicComplete I R.
Depth at least three implies depth at least two. Depth-two puncture restriction, composed with GammaSpecIso.inv, makes the canonical map r:R to Gamma(W,O) bijective.

Let k_n be GammaSpecIso.inv for R/I^(n+1), followed by pullback.snd.appTop. Naturality of GammaSpecIso and the pullback condition give openThickeningMap.appTop(r(b))=k_n(b mod I^(n+1)). This is the proved hrestriction calculation.

Formal-completion comparison gives a unique q in AdicCompletion I R for the compatible family. AdicCompletion.of_surjective gives b in R mapping to q. AdicCompletion.evalₐ_of identifies its evaluations with the reductions of b. The pullback calculation shows r(b) has every requested reduction.

For another section a with the reductions, write a=r(c) by surjectivity of r. The pullback calculation makes AdicCompletion.of(c) another representative of the same formal family, hence equal to q. AdicCompletion.of_injective gives c=b, and therefore a=r(b).

lean.statement:
theorem complete_punctured_principal_formal_sections
    (R : Type u) [CommRing R] [IsNoetherianRing R] [IsLocalRing R]
    [IsAdicComplete (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal R) R]
    (g : R) (hg : g ∈ IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal R)
    (hdepth : (3 : ℕ∞) ≤ IsLocalRing.depth (R := R) R)
    (W : (Spec (.of R)).Opens)
    (hW : ∀ x : Spec (.of R), x ∈ W ↔ x ≠ IsLocalRing.closedPoint R) :
    let f := Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span {g})
    ∀ s : ∀ n : ℕ, Γ(FiniteEtale.Adic.openThickening f W n, ⊤),
      (∀ n, (FiniteEtale.Adic.openThickeningTransition f W n).appTop
        (s (n + 1)) = s n) →
      ∃! a : Γ(W.toScheme, ⊤), ∀ n,
        (FiniteEtale.Adic.openThickeningMap f W n).appTop a = s n
